case_number: Civil Appeal Nos. of 2023 (Arising out of SLP (C) Nos.2373-2377 of 2020, SLP (C) No.24098 of 2022, etc.)
summary: Dispute over Paigah estates inherited from Nizam-era grants; historical examination of Paigah system as military-jagirs with obligations to maintain troops; inheritance principles under Hyderabad State law; partition validity without Nizam's consent; Haqe Inthezam (management rights) distribution; proprietary rights limited to usufruct, not absolute ownership; High Court's confirmation of Single Judge's judgment on execution obstruction appealed; final determination on estate division and rights.
final_judgment: Not explicitly stated in provided text; appeals filed against High Court's confirmation of Single Judge's judgment on execution matters.
